Brand-New Off-Grid Home with Mountain, Lake and Distant Sea Views

Set against the dramatic mountain backdrop of Betty's Bay, this newly completed single-storey home offers contemporary coastal living, generous proportions and the convenience of an off-grid energy system, all wrapped up in a fresh, modern design.

At the heart of the home is a spacious open-plan living, dining and kitchen area filled with natural light. Large stacking doors extend the living space onto the wooden decks, creating an effortless connection between indoors and out and making the home ideally suited to relaxed entertaining.

The kitchen forms part of the main living area and features clean modern finishes, ample cabinetry and adjoining scullery and laundry facilities. Dark cabinetry and black fittings are carried throughout the home, giving the interiors a striking contemporary edge, while warm vinyl flooring adds texture and character.

The north-facing main bedroom suite is positioned privately to one side of the living area and opens directly onto the rear deck. It includes built-in cupboards and a beautifully finished en-suite bathroom with a spacious walk-in shower.

On the opposite side of the home are two further bedrooms together with a study or nursery, offering flexibility for families, guests or those working from home. These rooms are served by a generously proportioned family bathroom, again finished with quality fittings and a large walk-in shower.

Both the front and north-facing sides of the home feature wooden decks, providing multiple outdoor living areas throughout the day. The rear deck includes a built-in braai and enjoys a sheltered north-facing position, ideal for entertaining while taking in the surrounding mountain landscape and distant lake and sea views.

The home has been designed with energy independence in mind and includes a **5kVA LuxPower inverter, 5.1kWh Photon/Megatron battery and five 550W Megatron solar panels**, while retaining full Eskom backup.

Additional features include gas geysers, built-in cupboards, fitted bathroom vanities, tiled bathroom floors and direct access into the home from the automated double garage.

The property is fenced on three sides, with boundary walls to either side of the front garden, while the largely untouched outdoor areas offer the new owner the opportunity to further landscape and personalise the property.

A compelling option for buyers looking for a brand-new, low-maintenance home with modern finishes, excellent indoor-outdoor flow and the freedom of off-grid living in one of Betty's Bay's most spectacular natural settings.
